recipes.name: Texas BBQ Beef Brisket
recipes.description: Low-and-slow smoked brisket with simple salt-pepper bark.

steps.instruction: Rub generously; rest overnight fridge.
Smoke 110-120°C fat-side down ~10-12h till probe-tender.
Wrap when stall passes; rest 2 hours minimum.

videos.videoTitle: Perfecting Texas Style Brisket - a complete guide

recipes.name: Classic Meatloaf
recipes.description: Glazed ketchup-topped beef loaf - weeknight Americana.

steps.instruction: Mix gently; loaf-pan or free-form.
Bake 175°C 45 min; glaze last 15.
Rest 10 before slicing.

videos.videoTitle: Classic Homemade Meatloaf | Easy Comfort Food Dinner

recipes.name: American Pot Roast
recipes.description: Chuck roast braised with carrots, potatoes and onion gravy.

steps.instruction: Dredge, sear roast deeply.
Add aromatics + stock; braise covered 3h at 160°C.
Veggies last hour; thicken juices.

videos.videoTitle: 1,000+ 5-Star Reviews | Ina Garten's Company Pot Roast | Barefoot Contessa | Food Network

recipes.name: Smash Burger
recipes.description: Thin patties smashed on ripping-hot griddle for lacy crust.

steps.instruction: Roll loose balls; smash flat on griddle 3 min.
Flip once; cheese on; stack doubles.
Toast buns in beef fat; sauce + build.

videos.videoTitle: Smash Burger Perfection - The BEST Burger Recipe EVER!

recipes.name: Loaded Baked Potato
recipes.description: Crisp-skinned russet split over buttered fluff, fully loaded.

steps.instruction: Salt-skin potatoes; bake 200°C ~65 min.
Split; fluff with butter.
Load everything; melt briefly under broiler.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger
recipes.description: Classic American beef patty topped with melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato, and special sauce on a toasted sesame bun.

steps.instruction: Form ground beef into patties and season with salt and pepper
Grill over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side
Add cheddar cheese in the last minute and close the lid to melt
Toast the bun halves on the grill
Assemble with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, ketchup, and mustard

recipes.name: Chili con Carne
recipes.description: Hearty Tex-Mex beef and bean chili simmered with tomatoes, onions, and bold spices.

steps.instruction: Brown the ground beef in a pot with olive oil over medium-high heat
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened
Stir in chili powder, cumin, and tomato paste
Add diced tomatoes, kidney beans, and a splash of water
Simmer on low for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally
Serve topped with shredded cheddar cheese

videos.videoTitle: This Chili con Carne Will Blow Your Mind

recipes.name: Meatloaf
recipes.description: Moist ground beef loaf glazed with tangy ketchup sauce and baked to perfection.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 175C (350F)
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, milk, garlic, and Worcestershire sauce
Shape into a loaf on a lined baking sheet
Mix ketchup, brown sugar, and mustard for the glaze and spread on top
Cook for 50 minutes until cooked through
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing

recipes.name: Classic Brisket
recipes.description: Slow-smoked beef brisket with a peppery bark, tender and juicy inside.

steps.instruction: Trim excess fat from the brisket leaving a thin cap
Apply mustard as a binder then rub with the spice blend
Let the brisket rest at room temperature for 30 minutes
Smoke at 110C (225F) for 10-12 hours until internal temp reaches 93C (200F)
Rest for at least 1 hour in butcher paper
Slice against the grain and serve

recipes.name: Corned Beef and Cabbage
recipes.description: Tender corned beef brisket braised with cabbage, potatoes, and carrots in savory broth.

steps.instruction: Place corned beef in a large pot and cover with cold water
Add the spice packet, bay leaves, onion, and garlic
Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer and cook for 2.5 hours
Add potatoes and carrots and cook for 15 minutes
Add cabbage wedges and cook for 10 more minutes
Slice beef against the grain and serve with vegetables

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beefsteak with melted provolone and sauteed onions on a hoagie roll.

steps.instruction: Slice ribeye paper-thin and season with salt and pepper
Saute onions and bell peppers in butter until caramelized
Cook the beef on high heat in a skillet, breaking into pieces
Layer provolone cheese over the beef and let melt
Pile everything onto a toasted hoagie roll
Serve immediately while hot and cheesy

recipes.name: Sloppy Joe
recipes.description: Sweet and tangy ground beef filling served on a soft hamburger bun.

steps.instruction: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat
Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic, cook until soft
Stir in ketchup, mustard, brown sugar, and Worcestershire sauce
Simmer on low for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally
Toast the hamburger buns lightly
Spoon the mixture onto the buns and serve

recipes.name: Prime Rib
recipes.description: Slow-roasted prime rib with a herb and garlic crust, served with au jus.

steps.instruction: Remove roast from fridge 2 hours before cooking to bring to room temperature
Mix butter, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper into a paste
Rub the herb paste all over the roast
Sear in a hot skillet on all sides until golden brown
Roast at 160C (320F) for 2-2.5 hours until internal temp is 54C (130F) for medium-rare
Rest for 20 minutes before carving and serve with au jus

recipes.name: Texas-Style Smoked Brisket
recipes.description: Salt-and-pepper crusted brisket slow-smoked over post oak for hours until fork-tender.

steps.instruction: Trim brisket to leave an even quarter-inch fat cap
Season generously with equal parts salt and pepper
Let the seasoned brisket rest uncovered in the fridge overnight
Place on the smoker at 107C (225F) fat side up
Smoke for 6-8 hours until a dark bark forms
Wrap in paper and continue cooking until internal temp reaches 96C (205F)
Rest wrapped for at least 1 hour, then slice against the grain

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef in crispy corn tortilla shells topped with fresh salsa and cheese.

steps.instruction: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat
Drain excess fat and stir in taco seasoning with water
Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened
Warm taco shells according to package directions
Fill shells with beef, lettuce, tomato, and cheese
Top with sour cream and salsa

recipes.name: Classic American Burger
recipes.description: Double-patty smash burger with American cheese, pickles, and tangy sauce on a soft bun.

steps.instruction: Divide beef into two loose balls, do not overwork the meat
Heat a cast iron skillet to very hot
Smash each ball flat and season with salt and pepper
Cook for 2 minutes, flip, and immediately add cheese
Cook 1 more minute until edges are crispy
Stack patties on a toasted bun with pickles, onion, and sauce

recipes.name: Steak au Poivre
recipes.description: Peppercorn-crusted pan-seared steak finished with a rich cognac cream sauce.

steps.instruction: Press crushed peppercorns firmly onto both sides of the steak
Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat
Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare
Remove steak and rest on a plate
Add shallots to the pan, cook for 1 minute
Add cognac and carefully flamb, then stir in cream and mustard
Return any juices and spoon sauce over the top

recipes.name: BBQ Brisket Plate
recipes.description: Smoky barbecue brisket with a sweet and tangy sauce served over white slices with pickles.

steps.instruction: Apply the BBQ rub generously to the brisket the night before
Smoke at 107C (225F) for 8-10 hours with hickory wood
Wrap in foil when the bark sets, around 6 hours in
Continue cooking until the internal temp reaches 93C (200F)
Rest the brisket for at least 45 minutes
Slice against the grain and serve on slices with sauce, slaw, and pickles

recipes.name: Beef Pot Pie
recipes.description: Hearty beef and vegetable filling topped with a flaky golden puff pastry crust.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 200C (400F)
Brown beef in butter, then add onion and garlic
Sprinkle flour over the meat and stir for 1 minute
Add broth, potatoes, and carrots, simmer for 15 minutes
Stir in peas, then pour filling into a baking dish
Drape puff pastry over the top, cut slits for steam
Cook for 25 minutes until golden and bubbly

recipes.name: Chicken Ranch Plate
recipes.description: Grilled chicken with crispy bacon, ranch dressing, and fresh veggies.

steps.instruction: Season and grill the chicken breast until cooked through
Cook bacon until crispy and crumble into pieces
Warm the flour tortilla slightly to make it pliable
Spread ranch dressing across the center of the tortilla
Layer chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato, cheese, and onion
Roll up tightly and slice in half diagonally

recipes.name: Southern Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Buttermilk-brined chicken in crackly seasoned crust.

steps.instruction: Brine 4+ hours buttermilk + salt.
Dredge flour-spice; rest 15 minutes.
Fry 165°C ~14-16 min dark gold; drain rack.

videos.videoTitle: Southern Fried Chicken! | Quick & Easy Recipe

recipes.name: Buffalo Wings
recipes.description: Crisp wings tossed in cayenne-butter Buffalo sauce with blue-cheese dip.

steps.instruction: Dry-rub baking powder; bake high 230°C 25-30 min OR deep fry.
Melt butter into hot sauce off heat.
Toss wings hard; serve dip + celery.

videos.videoTitle: How To Make Crispy Buffalo Chicken Wings

recipes.name: Nashville Hot Chicken
recipes.description: Cayenne-lard lacquered fried chicken over white bread with pickles.

steps.instruction: Brine 4 hours; dredge and fry till done.
Whisk spices into hot frying oil.
Brush lacquer over chicken; serve on bread + pickles.

videos.videoTitle: How to really make Nashville hot chicken!

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Chicken
recipes.description: Slow-smoke-free oven BBQ chicken pulled into tangy shreds.

steps.instruction: Rub; roast covered 160°C 60 min.
Shred; discard skin/bones.
Fold with warmed sauce + vinegar; pile on buns.

recipes.name: Chicken Nuggets
recipes.description: Crispy breaded chicken nuggets with a juicy interior, perfect for dipping.

steps.instruction: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika
Set up a breading station with flour, beaten egg, and panko breadcrumbs
Dredge each piece in flour, dip in egg, then coat in breadcrumbs
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
Sear nuggets for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through
Drain on a wire rack and serve with your favorite dipping sauce

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Sticky, smoky barbecue chicken wings until crispy and glazed with sauce.

steps.instruction: Pat wings completely dry with paper towels
Toss wings with olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, and pepper
Arrange on a wire rack over a baking sheet
Cook at 220C (425F) for 40-45 minutes, flipping halfway
Heat BBQ sauce in a small saucepan
Toss crispy wings in warm sauce and serve with ranch

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken
recipes.description: Whole grilled chicken basted in smoky sweet barbecue sauce until caramelized.

steps.instruction: Spatchcock the chicken by removing the backbone and pressing flat
Mix olive oil with garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, brown sugar, salt, and pepper
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken
Grill skin-side down over medium heat for 20 minutes
Flip and brush generously with BBQ sauce
Continue grilling for 15 more minutes, basting with sauce periodically
Let rest 10 minutes before carving

recipes.name: Bourbon Chicken
recipes.description: Sweet and savory chicken thighs glazed in a sticky bourbon sauce with warm spices.

steps.instruction: Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Sear chicken pieces until golden brown on all sides
Mix bourbon, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, vinegar, and ketchup
Pour the sauce over the chicken and bring to a simmer
Cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens
Serve over steamed rice

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.description: Crispy breaded chicken cutlet topped with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella cheese.

steps.instruction: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder
Dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
Sear chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until golden
Place on a baking sheet, top each with marinara and mozzarella
Broil for 2-3 minutes until cheese is bubbly and melted
Sprinkle with parmesan before serving

recipes.name: Chicken and Dumplings
recipes.description: Tender chicken and vegetables in creamy broth topped with fluffy homemade dumplings.

steps.instruction: Cook chicken thighs in a pot with chicken broth, onion, carrots, celery, and bay leaf
Remove chicken, shred the meat, and return to pot
For dumplings, mix flour, baking powder, salt, cold butter, and milk into a soft dough
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto the simmering broth
Cover and cook for 15 minutes without lifting the lid
Remove bay leaf and serve hot

recipes.name: Hot Honey Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy chicken thighs drizzled with spicy honey glaze and finished with a kick.

steps.instruction: Mix flour, cornstarch, garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, and pepper
Dredge chicken thighs in the flour mixture, pressing to adhere
Heat oil to 175C (350F) in a deep skillet
Sear chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through
Drain on a wire rack
Heat honey and hot sauce together until combined
Drizzle the hot honey over the chicken

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.description: Crispy flour tortilla filled with seasoned chicken, melted cheese, and peppers.

steps.instruction: Season and cook chicken breast until done, then slice thinly
Saute bell pepper, onion, and jalapeno until softened
Place one tortilla in a hot skillet, sprinkle cheese on half
Layer chicken and vegetables over the cheese, add more cheese on top
Fold the tortilla in half and cook until golden on each side
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa

recipes.name: Chicken Tenders
recipes.description: Juicy strips of chicken breast coated in seasoned flour until golden brown.

steps.instruction: Cut chicken breast into even strips and season with salt and pepper
Set up three bowls with flour, beaten eggs, and seasoned breadcrumbs
Coat each strip in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs
Heat oil to 175C (350F) in a deep pan
Sear tenders for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through
Drain on paper towels and serve with honey mustard

recipes.name: Rotisserie Chicken
recipes.description: Whole chicken seasoned with herbs and butter, until the skin is golden and crisp.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 220C (425F)
Mix softened butter with garlic, rosemary, thyme, lemon zest, salt, and pepper
Loosen the skin and rub the herb butter underneath
Rub olive oil and lemon juice over the outside of the chicken
Tie legs together and tuck wing tips under
Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes until internal temp reaches 74C (165F)
Rest for 15 minutes before carving

recipes.name: Chicken Rice Skillet
recipes.description: Wok-style rice with diced chicken, scrambled eggs, vegetables, and savory soy sauce.

steps.instruction: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat
Cook diced chicken until golden and cooked through, set aside
Scramble eggs in the wok, break into pieces, and set aside
Add more oil, stir-fry garlic, carrots, and peas for 2 minutes
Add cold rice and break up clumps, stir-fry for 3 minutes
Return chicken and eggs, add soy sauce and sesame oil
Toss everything together and garnish with green onion

recipes.name: Orange Chicken
recipes.description: Tender battered chicken pieces tossed in a sweet and tangy orange glaze.

steps.instruction: Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper for the batter
Dip chicken cubes in egg then the flour mixture
Heat oil to 175C (350F) and sear chicken until golden, about 4 minutes
Drain on a wire rack
Combine orange juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger in a saucepan
Simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes
Toss chicken in the orange sauce and garnish with green onion

recipes.name: Smoked Chicken
recipes.description: Whole chicken rubbed with smoky spices and slow-smoked over apple wood.

steps.instruction: Mix all the spices with olive oil to form a paste
Rub the paste all over the chicken, including under the skin
Let the chicken rest in the fridge for 2 hours
Set up smoker with apple wood chips at 120C (250F)
Smoke the chicken for 2.5-3 hours until internal temp reaches 74C (165F)
Rest for 15 minutes before carving

recipes.name: Southwest Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine lettuce with black beans, corn, avocado, and tangy cilantro-lime dressing.

steps.instruction: Chop romaine and arrange in a bowl
Top with black beans, corn, cherry tomatoes, avocado, and red onion
Whisk lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper for dressing
Pour dressing over the salad
Garnish with fresh cilantro, tortilla strips, and grilled chicken
Toss gently before serving

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.description: Velvety smooth cheddar soup loaded with tender broccoli florets and a hint of nutmeg.

steps.instruction: Melt butter in a pot and saute onion and garlic until soft
Sprinkle flour and stir for 1 minute to make a roux
Gradually whisk in chicken broth until smooth
Add carrots and broccoli, simmer for 15 minutes until tender
Stir in heavy cream and cheddar cheese until melted and smooth
Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper and serve hot

videos.videoTitle: 30 Minute Broccoli Cheddar Soup (Better than Panera!)

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Simple Italian-American salad of fresh tomato, mozzarella, and basil with balsamic glaze.

steps.instruction: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into even rounds
Arrange alternating slices on a serving plate
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil
Finish with a drizzle of balsamic glaze
Season with flaky sea salt, fresh black pepper, and sliced chicken

videos.videoTitle: Easy Caprese Salad Recipe with Balsamic Glaze

recipes.name: Baked Mac & Cheese
recipes.description: Cheddar-gruyère custard macaroni under a crumb lid.

steps.instruction: Boil pasta shy; make mornay; fold together with egg.
Dish up; crumb top.
Bake 190°C 25 min bubbling.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
recipes.description: The diner duo: crisp cheddar toasties dunked in creamy tomato soup.

steps.instruction: Butter outsides; low-medium grill till molten center.
Simmer soup; blitz smooth; cream swirl.
Cut diagonally; dunk aggressively.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Chili
recipes.description: Three-bean chili with smoky chipotle depth, no meat needed.

steps.instruction: Sweat veg; bloom spices.
Add tomatoes + beans; simmer 40 min.
Season lime-salty; fixings bar.

recipes.name: Pastrami Sandwich
recipes.description: Stacked spiced and smoked pastrami on rye with yellow mustard.

steps.instruction: Steam the pastrami slices over boiling water for 5-8 minutes until hot and tender
Lightly toast the rye slices
Spread yellow mustard on both slices
Layer the pastrami generously on one slice
Top with Swiss cheese if desired and close the sandwich
Serve with a dill pickle on the side

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipes.description: Golden, buttery toasted slices with melted cheddar and American cheese inside.

steps.instruction: Butter one side of each slice, or spread mayonnaise for extra crispness
Layer cheddar and American cheese between the slices
Heat a skillet over medium-low heat
Cook the sandwich for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cheese is melted
Press gently with a spatula while cooking
Slice diagonally and serve hot

recipes.name: Tomato Mozzarella Salad
recipes.description: Fresh slices of ripe tomato and creamy mozzarella drizzled with basil oil.

steps.instruction: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into even rounds
Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a plate
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and balsamic vinegar
Season with kosher salt and freshly cracked black pepper
Scatter toasted pine nuts on top and serve immediately

videos.videoTitle: How To Make Tomatoes and Mozzarella - Easy Recipe Tutorial

recipes.name: Roasted Vegetable Bowl
recipes.description: Colorful medley of roasted vegetables over quinoa with tahini dressing.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 210C (410F)
Toss sweet potato, broccoli, bell pepper, and onion with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes until caramelized
Cook quinoa according to package directions
Mix tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and water for the dressing
Assemble bowls with quinoa, roasted vegetables, and chickpeas
Drizzle with tahini dressing

videos.videoTitle: ROASTED VEGETABLES | easy oven roasted recipe

recipes.name: Stuffed Peppers
recipes.description: Colorful bell peppers filled with seasoned rice, beans, corn, and topped with melted cheese.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 190C (375F)
Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft
Mix rice, black beans, corn, tomatoes, cumin, and chili powder with the onion mixture
Stuff the pepper halves with the filling
Place in a baking dish and cover with foil
Cook for 30 minutes, uncover, top with cheese, and cook 10 more minutes
Let rest 5 minutes before serving

recipes.name: Veggie Tacos
recipes.description: Spiced sweet potato and black bean tacos topped with avocado crema and pickled onions.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 200C (400F)
Toss sweet potato cubes with olive oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper
Roast for 20 minutes until tender and caramelized
Mash avocado with lime juice and a pinch of salt for crema
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet
Fill tortillas with roasted sweet potato, black beans, and cabbage
Top with avocado crema, pickled onion, and cilantro

recipes.name: Macaroni Salad
recipes.description: Creamy American-style macaroni salad with celery, onion, and sweet relish.

steps.instruction: Cook macaroni according to package directions, rinse under cold water until cool
Whisk mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper for dressing
Combine cooled macaroni, celery, red onion, relish, chopped egg, and tuna
Pour dressing over the mixture and fold gently to combine
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving
Garnish with a sprinkle of paprika

recipes.name: Italian Pasta Salad
recipes.description: Colorful rotini pasta salad with olives, peppers, and Italian vinaigrette.

steps.instruction: Cook rotini according to package directions, rinse under cold water
Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces
Combine pasta, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, onion, bell pepper, and mozzarella pearls
Pour Italian dressing over the salad and toss to coat
Add parmesan cheese and torn basil
Toss gently and serve chilled

recipes.name: Fresh Fruit Salad
recipes.description: Seasonal mix of berries, melon, and citrus with yogurt, nuts, and honey-lime dressing.

steps.instruction: Wash and prepare all the fruit
Cut strawberries, watermelon, and kiwi into bite-sized pieces
Combine all fruit in a large bowl
Whisk honey and lime juice together for the dressing
Pour the dressing over the fruit and toss gently
Top with greek yogurt and sliced almonds
Garnish with fresh mint and serve chilled

recipes.name: Black Bean Burger
recipes.description: Hearty veggie burger with black beans

steps.instruction: Mash black beans.
Mix with breadcrumbs, egg, and seasonings.
Form into patties.
Pan-fry or grill until crispy.

recipes.name: Classic Coleslaw
recipes.description: Creamy cabbage and carrot slaw

steps.instruction: Shred cabbage and grate carrot.
Mix mayo, vinegar, sugar, and celery seed.
Toss vegetables with dressing.
Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Southern Baked Beans
recipes.description: Sweet and smoky baked beans

steps.instruction: Soak and cook beans.
Mix sauce ingredients.
Combine and bake at 160C.
Cook for 1.5 hours until thick.

recipes.name: Fresh Fruit Salad Cup
recipes.description: Seasonal mixed fruit with mint dressing

steps.instruction: Wash and cut all fruit.
Combine in a bowl.
Mix lime juice and honey.
Toss fruit with dressing and garnish with mint.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich Toast
recipes.description: Buttery crispy grilled cheese

steps.instruction: Butter bread slices.
Place cheese between bread.
Grill in pan until golden.
Serve with tomato soup.

recipes.name: Loaded Potato Soup
recipes.description: Creamy potato soup loaded with bacon, cheddar cheese, sour cream, and chives.

steps.instruction: Melt butter in a large pot and saute onion and garlic until soft
Add cubed potatoes and chicken broth, bring to a boil
Cook until potatoes are fork-tender, about 15 minutes
Mash about half the potatoes in the pot for a chunky texture
Stir in milk and heat through
Serve topped with cheddar, bacon, sour cream, and chives

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan Marinara
recipes.description: Breaded chicken with marinara and melted mozzarella

steps.instruction: Pound chicken thin.
Dredge in egg and breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry until golden.
Top with marinara and mozzarella, bake until bubbly.

recipes.name: Creamy Coleslaw
recipes.description: Crisp shredded cabbage and carrots tossed in a tangy, creamy dressing.

steps.instruction: Shred cabbage finely and grate carrots
Whisk mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, sugar, Dijon mustard, celery seed, salt, and pepper
Pour dressing over the shredded vegetables
Toss thoroughly to coat everything evenly
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let flavors meld
Toss again before serving

recipes.name: New York Cheesecake
recipes.description: Dense rich baked cheesecake on graham crust, sour-cream topped.

steps.instruction: Crust par-baked; batter minimal-air mixed.
Water bath 160°C ~70 min wobble-center.
Topping 10 min; cool slow; chill overnight.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Brown-butter chewy centers, crisp edges, chocolate puddles.

steps.instruction: Cream butter-sugars-eggs; dry in.
Chill dough 24h ideally.
Scoop big; bake 180°C 11-13 min; salt flakes.

recipes.name: Key Lime Pie
recipes.description: Tangy and sweet Key lime custard in a buttery graham cracker crust topped with whipped cream.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 175C (350F)
Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press into a 9-inch pie dish
Cook crust for 8 minutes until set, let cool
Whisk egg yolks, sweetened condensed milk, key lime juice, and lime zest
Pour filling into the cooled crust
Cook for 15 minutes until the filling is just set
Cool completely, then chill for at least 2 hours
Whip cream with powdered sugar and pipe on top before serving

videos.videoTitle: The Best Key Lime Pie Recipe

recipes.name: Banana Pudding
recipes.description: Layers of vanilla wafers, fresh banana slices, and creamy vanilla pudding.

steps.instruction: Whisk vanilla pudding mix with whole milk for 2 minutes, let set for 5 minutes
Fold in sweetened condensed milk and vanilla extract
Layer vanilla wafers in the bottom of a dish
Add a layer of sliced bananas over the wafers
Spread half the pudding over the bananas
Repeat layers: wafers, bananas, remaining pudding
Top with whipped cream and chill for at least 4 hours
Serve cold

recipes.name: Pecan Pie
recipes.description: Rich, gooey filling of caramelized corn syrup and pecans in a flaky pie crust.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 175C (350F)
Roll out pie crust and fit into a 9-inch pie dish
Whisk corn syrup, brown sugar, eggs, melted butter, vanilla, salt, and flour
Arrange pecan halves evenly on the bottom of the crust
Carefully pour the filling over the pecans
Cook for 50-60 minutes until the filling is set but still has a slight jiggle
Cool completely at room temperature, then chill for at least 2 hours
Serve at room temperature or slightly warm

recipes.name: Peach Cobbler
recipes.description: Juicy peach filling topped with a golden, buttery batter until perfectly caramelized.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 190C (375F)
Toss sliced peaches with brown sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, and cinnamon
Pour peach filling into a buttered baking dish
Whisk flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, and salt
Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
Stir in milk and vanilla until a batter forms
Drop spoonfuls of batter over the peaches
Cook for 35-40 minutes until the topping is golden and fruit is bubbling

recipes.name: Pound Cake
recipes.description: Dense, buttery cake with a tender crumb and golden crust, classic American baking.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 175C (350F) and grease a loaf pan
Cream butter and sugar together until very light and fluffy, about 5 minutes
Beat in eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition
Add vanilla extract and mix to combine
Whisk flour, whey protein, baking powder, and salt together
Alternate adding the dry ingredients and milk to the batter in three additions
Pour into the prepared pan and smooth the top
Cook for 55-65 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack

recipes.name: Red Velvet Cake
recipes.description: Moist red velvet layers with tangy cream cheese frosting, a Southern classic.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 175C (350F) and prepare two round cake pans
Whisk flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt in one bowl
Whisk sugar, oil, eggs, buttermilk, food coloring, and vanilla in another bowl
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed
Stir in white vinegar and pour into prepared pans
Cook for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean
Cool completely before frosting
For frosting, beat cream cheese and butter until smooth, then beat in powdered sugar and vanilla
Frost between the layers and over the entire cake

recipes.name: Pumpkin Pie
recipes.description: Silky spiced pumpkin custard in a flaky pie crust, a Thanksgiving staple.

steps.instruction: Preheat to 220C (425F)
Roll out pie crust and fit into a 9-inch pie dish
Whisk pumpkin puree, sweetened condensed milk, eggs, and all spices until smooth
Pour filling into the pie crust
Cook at 220C (425F) for 15 minutes, then reduce to 165C (330F) and cook 35-40 more minutes
The pie is done when the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly
Cool completely at room temperature, then chill for at least 3 hours
Serve chilled with whipped cream

recipes.name: Berry Cobbler
recipes.description: Warm mixed berry dessert with biscuit topping

steps.instruction: Place berries in a baking dish.
Mix flour, sugar, and baking powder.
Add milk and butter to make batter.
Pour over berries and bake at 190C for 30 minutes.
